machine.name: Home Caregiver Support Response Interconnect
machine.description: Published personal-health bridge bus that composes caregiver burden, pediatric nutrition, child development, household food access, and social support context into a compact fan-out lane for respite crisis response, family resource support, child development/nutrition follow-up, and stable monitoring. PE owns source composition and writes the compact input lane; RE evaluates this machine as ordinary vector state.

metadata.domain: Personal Health - Published Caregiver Support Response Bus
metadata.author: Reality Engine

publishedDomainBus.name: Personal Health Caregiver Support Response Bus
publishedDomainBus.description: Domain-level published bus for caregiver burden, pediatric nutrition, child development, food access, and social support interconnection.

downstreamConsumers.purpose: dispatch care coordination agent for caregiver support
guardrail inequitable family support and access burden
SNAP eligibility support when household food burden affects caregiving
WIC referral for child nutrition and family support

fanOutPolicy.notes: PE selects consumers from outputMatchesAny after RE emits the bus output. Respite crisis, family resource support, child development/nutrition follow-up, and stable monitoring intentionally fan out to different consumers.

writeBack.name: localAIStack caregiver support response resolver completion
semantics: caregiver respite crisis resolved or acknowledged
family resource support resolved or acknowledged
child development nutrition follow-up resolved or acknowledged
caregiver stable monitoring resolved or acknowledged

sourceMapping.name: localAIStack caregiver support response resolver completion

localAIResolver.notes: Resolver metadata is consumed by PE startup configuration. It intentionally does not create metadata.agentBinding because this bridge machine is not an agent-dispatcher and RE should see only ordinary vector state.

rules.description: CAREGIVER_RESPITE_CRISIS: caregiver burnout with child and household co-risk at [4410:4414]
FAMILY_RESOURCE_SUPPORT: high caregiver burden with resource or social-support barriers at [4410:4414]
CHILD_DEVELOPMENT_NUTRITION_FOLLOWUP: child nutrition/development concerns with caregiver strain at [4410:4414]
CAREGIVER_STABLE_MONITORING: caregiver, child, and household lanes stable at [4410:4414]

governance.notes: Published PE-composed bridge bus for caregiver support response. RE evaluates only vector state; PE owns source provenance and completion ingestion.

sequences.name: Caregiver burnout + child risk + food/social isolation -> respite crisis response

metadata.description: Caregiver burnout coincides with pediatric health/development risk, food crisis, and severe isolation.

metadata.action: Route urgent respite, care coordination, family stabilization, and maternal-child governance support.

sequences.name: High burden + household resource barriers -> family resource support

metadata.description: Caregiver burden is high and appears driven by food assistance need, social withdrawal, and child-support access gaps.

metadata.action: Route benefits, WIC/SNAP, family stabilization, parent coaching, and care-resource support.

sequences.name: Moderate burden + child nutrition/development concerns -> child follow-up

metadata.description: Caregiver burden is moderate with child micronutrient or learning concerns and manageable household context.

metadata.action: Route pediatric nutrition, developmental follow-up, school accommodation, and family-health resource support.

sequences.name: Caregiver coping + child and household supports stable -> stable monitoring

metadata.description: Caregiver, child nutrition, child development, food access, and social support lanes are stable.

metadata.action: Continue lightweight family-health and Life Balance monitoring.
